source_instruction: i'm looking for a wide leg jeans with regular fit and tummy control. also, choose 3x large zz-zm black colored one.
query:
I spent my whole Saturday morning rearranging the overgrown window box out on my fire escape, yanking out the scraggly dead mint that got crispy in last week’s random heat spike and tucking in bright trailing petunias and a few clumps of lemon basil I picked up from the neighborhood plant swap. The old guy running the swap table gave me a free packet of wildflower seeds because I helped him carry a flat of succulents to his beat-up minivan when his bad knee acted up, and I even found a chipped little ceramic frog figurine to prop in the corner of the box for a silly, whimsical touch. I was so covered in potting soil by the time I finished that I tracked dark dirt all across my kitchen rug when I went inside to wash my hands, and my cat immediately hopped up on the windowsill to sniff every new leaf like she was conducting a very serious quality inspection.
I need a pair of women’s jeans that are slim fit, have tummy control, a wide leg, and come with a removable fabric belt, in the zz-zmblack color and 3x-large size. I don’t want to spend too much on them, so can you pull up options that fit what I’m looking for? I’d prefer pairs that are in stock to ship out quickly too, no backorders please.
